title: A Carrier Launches a Fighter Jet From 0 to 165 mph in 2 Seconds

scenes.text: Zero to 165 miles an hour in two seconds.
scenes.keywords: fighter jet catapult launch aircraft carrier

scenes.text: That is how a warship launches a loaded fighter jet.
The jet sits on a steam-powered catapult only about 300 feet long.
A loaded Super Hornet weighs around thirty tons.
Yet it flies off the bow in just over two seconds.
Zero to 165. Two seconds. Three hundred feet. Watch it again.

description:
A steam catapult flings a loaded fighter jet from zero to about 165 miles an hour in roughly two seconds, along a track only about 300 feet long.
A loaded Super Hornet weighs around thirty tons.
Would you ride one? Comment below.
first_comment: Zero to 165 in two seconds. Would you sit in that cockpit?
